opening.argument: The record presents a coordinated income pitch, not merely general market commentary. It highlights PancakeSwap farming on Aptos, with the displayed Farms page showing liquidity-pool entries and the instruction to stake LP tokens to earn. The speaker expressly says, "I recommend USDC with USD SDT 17% APR," then urges viewers to "Create a strategy" and says they can "gain income by playing." A free-BTC claim is likewise used to direct viewers to an external site. Those direct recommendations, a specific return figure, and promotional solicitation establish the investment-pool pitch. The disclaimer that investments are not recommended and that projects may not produce positive results does not erase the accompanying invitation to pursue income.

citations.quote: At Aptos blockchain PancakeSwap is doing the same as in BNB Chain.

Create a strategy, do you still have time to take advantage of bear market?
So you can take advantage of this farm here and gain income by playing.
